text:
Sam: quick flag 1: we're seeing a latency bump on some Llama3/13B configs after the recent kernel-selector tweak. p95 up ~20% for seq ranges 128-512 on ded.

Anika: which selector rule changed? the head_dim heuristic or the rope_theta-aware path?

Sam: selector started preferring fused_attn_path when head_dim==128 and seq>128. profiler shows more memcpy time and KV churn. snippet: 
```
[fused_attn_path] exec=2.0ms memcpy=0.9ms kv_copy_tail=0.8ms
[baseline generic] exec=1.3ms memcpy=0.05ms kv_copy_tail=0.1ms
kv_reuse_ratio drop 0.82 -> 0.45
evictions/sec 7 -> 44
```

Josh: hm. fused path wins on homogeneous long-streams but loses when KV reuse is low or chat templates vary. did we also change rope_theta defaults recently?

Sam: yes we bumped rope_theta scaling slightly in the Llama3 catalog last week to better match seq-generalization. could be interacting.

Li: impact chain makes sense: rope_theta affects attention phase steer, can shift attention magnitudes -> small changes in kv layout/serialization patterns under quantization -> more memmoves. We should test RMSNorm vs RMSNorm+SiLU codepath too; nonlinearity can alter activation sparsity which affects fused kernel perf.

Marta: proposed quick experiment plan: synthetic replay with three prefixes (32, 256, 768), two kernel toggles (fused/generic), and rmsnorm toggle. Measure p50/p95, kv_reuse_ratio, and memcpy-ms.

Anika: also propose a lightweight heuristic in selector: prefer fused only when reuse_ratio >= 0.7 AND seq_median >= 256 AND head_dim in {64,128,256} (but add a runtime backoff when eviction spike observed).

Sam: ran the synthetic run on dev-gpu-6. results below:
```
prefix 32, fused: p95=180ms reuse=0.68 evict/sec=12 memcpy=0.4ms
prefix 32, generic: p95=150ms reuse=0.68 evict/sec=11 memcpy=0.05ms

prefix 256, fused: p95=125ms reuse=0.85 evict/sec=4 memcpy=0.2ms
prefix 256, generic: p95=140ms reuse=0.85 evict/sec=4 memcpy=0.06ms

prefix 768, fused: p95=300ms reuse=0.42 evict/sec=49 memcpy=1.0ms
prefix 768, generic: p95=260ms reuse=0.42 evict/sec=47 memcpy=0.08ms
```

Josh: interesting: fused loses at both tiny and very long prefixes here. small prefixes because batch packing creates short-window overhead; long prefixes due to low reuse. So reuse_ratio alone isn't sufficient; seq variance matters.

Li: agree. suggest composite metric reuse_score = reuse_ratio * (1 - seq_variance_norm). Gate fused if reuse_score > 0.6. Also add a short-term decay: if evictions spike > 3x baseline in <1min, force a fallback to generic for that route for N minutes.

Marta: example selector rule patch:
```
"kernel_selector": [
  {"cond": "reuse_score>=0.6 && head_dim==128 && seq_median>=128", "kernel": "fused_attn_path"},
  {"cond": "default", "kernel": "generic_attn"}
],
"fallbacks": {"evict_spike_factor": 3, "cooldown_secs": 300}
```

Sam: rolled a 5% canary (deploy-bot kicked off).
deploy-bot: Canary 9876 started - routes=5% variant=kernel-reuse-score-2026-03-18 status=running

Anika: for rope_theta/RMSNorm interaction: Sam can you run a micro-benchmark comparing attention key L2 norms across rope_theta=orig vs rope_theta=scaled and rmsnorm vs rmsnorm+siLU? if norms deviate >5% we might need a tiny rescale before quant/pack.

Sam: on it. initial micro-bench: rope_theta scaled -> key_norm mean -3.8% vs baseline; adding SiLU path -> key_norm mean +6.1% vs RMSNorm only. So combined could swing ~10% which aligns with observed eviction heuristics shifting.

Li: that 10% swing is actionable. Add prepack rescale factor = 1 / sqrt(1 + delta_var) or simple clamp to keep norms in expected band. Also add unit tests to perf-regression harness: simulate head_dim permutations and rope_theta toggles.

Marta: ops: if canary metrics look good after 30m, promote to 25% and add metric dashboards: kv_reuse_ratio per model-version, reuse_score heatmap, and eviction_spike alerts. Also document the invariant: fused kernels assume stable reuse patterns and bounded attn-norm variance.

Sam: 35m update: canary p95 down ~10% vs bad baseline, evictions back near baseline, reuse_score routing diverted ~7% to generic which removed most spikes. will prepare PR with selector rule + fallback cooldown + small prepack rescale patch.

Anika: perfect. please include changelog note about rope_theta and SiLU interaction so catalog owners are aware. good triage everyone.
